method: static HTML/RSC/CSS/JS analysis of / and 232 entry pages; live Chromium 141 via Playwright 1.56.1 at 1440x900 and 390x844. Bundled Chromium has no H.264 support, so video playback is NOT verified.
privacy_note: Creator titles, handles, and prompt text are deliberately omitted; entries_index holds structural flags and slugs only.

routes.type: entry (standalone page on direct load; modal over / when opened from a card)
routes.title: entry title (no site suffix)

data_model.source: Next.js RSC payload on /; per-entry metadata on /<slug>

sort_rules.Popular: server-provided order, no client sort (ranking metric not exposed in payload; not verified)

components.name: HeroSignup
components.notes: h1 + subtitle; email signup card (server action "subscribe", not invoked)

components.name: FilterBar
components.notes: Radix toggle group (Prompt, Skill), Select (Popular, Recent), pause toggle persisted in localStorage pm:previews

components.name: Gallery
components.notes: JS-measured masonry; 232 li items; posters lazy except first 9 (eager, fetchpriority high)

components.name: EntryCard
components.notes: Link /<slug>; aspect-ratio from entry width/height; BlurPoster + preview video (IntersectionObserver, 25% threshold); avatar with fallback letter; @handle; badges

components.name: EntryModal
components.where: intercepted over / when a card is clicked (parallel route @modal)
components.notes: shared layout animation (layoutId card-/media-<slug>); prev/next, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, Escape closes; document.title not updated

components.name: EntryPage
components.notes: media player (Play, Seek, Unmute; preload=auto), creator block, h1, prompt or skill section, source line, dl metadata, "All videos" back link, footer

components.name: SubmitDialog
components.notes: Post URL (required), where-prompt radio (required), honeypot website; reviewed-by-hand copy; not submitted

design_tokens.color_mode: light only (color-scheme: light; dark: variants compiled under :where(.never-dark ...) and never apply)

fonts.sans: Geist (variable 100-900, normal style), subsets: 5 woff2 files; fallback "Geist Fallback"
fonts.mono: Geist Mono (variable 100-900), subsets: 6 woff2 files; declared, no element on / or entry pages computes it

transitions.reduced_motion: transition-duration .01ms !important; shimmer disabled; previews default paused

focus.utility_controls: focus-visible:ring-3 ring-ring/50 + border-ring (about 1.3:1 halo, 1.7:1 border on white)

hover.card: group-hover ring black/15; handle text -> foreground

media.video_codec: H.264 (avc1) + AAC for full video; H.264 video only for preview; no WebM/AV1 sources

behaviors_verified_live.card_click: opens modal over grid at /<slug>; document.title stays Prompt Motion; 232 cards still mounted
behaviors_verified_live.arrow_keys_in_modal: ArrowRight and ArrowLeft step to next/previous entry in current order
behaviors_verified_live.pause_toggle: localStorage pm:previews = paused|playing; state survives reload; reduced-motion default = on
behaviors_verified_live.show_all: expands clamped prompt (216px to 1656px for 2,711 chars)
behaviors_verified_live.signup_collapse: aria-expanded toggles; label becomes Open signup; input hidden

not_verified: video playback and hover/in-view preview playback (H.264 unsupported in bundled Chromium)
actual bytes transferred by preload=auto on entry page
email signup and submit-dialog submission (intentionally not exercised)
